name: an instinct

phase_0.boundary_condition: the species-specific genetic architecture of the organism

VINIT.justification: the pre-stimulus state prior to environmental activation

TANCH.justification: the total survival constraint that defines the utility of the drive

AFWD.justification: the electrochemical progression toward motor actuation

AREV.justification: the activation of counter-regulatory systems to restore quiescence

CLINK.justification: the chaining of sensory input to involuntary output

IMSCRIB.justification: the realization that the organism is the agent of its own motion

FSPLIT.justification: the bifurcation of raw sensory data into fight and flight pathways

FFUSE.justification: the integration of divergent motor impulses into a singular survival action

EVALT.justification: the positive feedback derived from satisfying the biological urge

EVALF.justification: the failure to act or the negation of the drive by external threat

ENGAGR.justification: the execution of irrelevant behaviors when two instincts conflict simultaneously

IFIX.justification: the irreversible chemical modification indicating frequent pathway activation

phase_3.void_description: quiescent homeostasis before any environmental disturbance occurs
phase_3.true_description: effective execution of the pre-programmed motor pattern
phase_3.false_description: suppression of the response due to superior environmental overwhelming
phase_3.both_description: state of ambivalence where competing survival drives lock the organism in tension

steps.domain_action: access the unexpressed genetic blueprint of the nervous system
associate the blueprint with the cellular metabolic state
recognize an external environmental trigger via sensory receptors
identify the trigger as a relevant biological signal
divide the sensory signal into distinct processing channels
initiate a high-priority motor command loop
satisfy the biological necessity of the immediate stimulus
trigger a metabolic cool-down to prevent tissue damage
register any secondary threats that inhibit the primary action
combine the motor impulses into a unified organismic posture
connect the posture to the resulting environmental change
confirm the organism survives the interaction
record the survival success as a structural bias in future firing
seal the recursive cycle within the long-term fitness boundary

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the transcription-translation machinery that builds neural structures
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: axonal action potentials and neurotransmitter diffusion
phase_5.memory_mechanism: potentiated synaptic weights in the lower brain regions
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the endocrine system providing hormonal timing and priority
phase_5.alfs_store: the ancestral genome which provides the hardware specification

phase_6.pre_cycle_state: high potential chemical energy stored in glucose
phase_6.post_cycle_state: dissipated heat and increased environmental disorder
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the localized order of the instinct preserves the higher-order structure of the organism
